deviations.what: The Slider's `liveChange` attribute is dropped (the expression binding needs no event). **e2e-verified 2026-08-01** (scripts/e2e-smoke.mjs interaction, transpiled backend + real browser): one keyboard step on the Slider moves the containerLayout (VerticalLayout) width to 99% with no round-trip - the expression binding replaces onSliderMoved completely. Residual: the BlockLayout's own reflow inside the resized layout.

The SegmentedButton.selectedKey and the BlockLayout.background are both two-way bound to the same /SELECTEDBACKGROUND field, so changing the segmented button updates the BlockLayout background entirely on the client with no round-trip (the app-048/003 shared-binding idiom, matching the original {/selectedBackground} on both). The field is seeded with the enum default Default (the original leaves /selectedBackground undefined; an empty string would fail BlockBackgroundType validateProperty). Live sync unverified. **e2e-verified 2026-08-04** (nightly e2e interaction, meta/interactions/z2ui5_cl_smpc_app_214.mjs). (Scope corrected 2026-08-23: that module runs sliderDrivenWidth only - it never clicks a SegmentedButtonItem and never reads BlockLayout.getBackground( ), so the shared-binding claim beside it is unverified. The mechanism is sound: SegmentedButton writes selectedKey through setProperty, and ManagedObject.setProperty runs updateModelProperty regardless of the suppress flag.)

The 123 /ProductCollection rows are inlined from the shared mock ui5/mock/products.json; only the columns the table binds are kept (productid,name,suppliername,width,depth,height,dimunit,weightmeasure,weightunit,price,currencycode). Dimension and weight fields are TYPE string to preserve exact decimals for the display templates; price is TYPE p DECIMALS 2 for the sap.ui.model.type.Currency binding. Data verified against the mock.
